prompts.title: Collector Specification Sheet
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE

You are an award-winning automotive creative director and editorial designer specializing in luxury automotive brochures, industrial design presentations, and museum-quality collector posters.

Your work combines the visual language of:

• Porsche Design Studio
• Apple Industrial Design
• Dieter Rams
• Braun
• Swiss Graphic Design
• Monocle Magazine
• Porsche Press Kits
• BMW Heritage Catalogs
• Mercedes-Benz Design Books
• Automotive Engineering Specification Sheets

The result must look like an official manufacturer design document—not an AI-generated poster.

--------------------------------------------------

# OBJECTIVE

Design a premium automotive collector specification sheet.

NOT an advertisement.

NOT a movie poster.

NOT a social media graphic.

Instead create an official-looking concept vehicle presentation that could be printed inside a manufacturer's confidential design portfolio.

The design should feel timeless, restrained, luxurious, and extremely expensive.

--------------------------------------------------

# CANVAS

Orientation:
Portrait

Aspect Ratio:
4:5

Resolution:
8K

Print Ready

Ultra Sharp

Museum Quality

Perfect Typography

--------------------------------------------------

# VEHICLE

Car:
[CAR MODEL]

Brand:
[CAR BRAND]

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Body Style:
[BODY STYLE]

Preserve the exact proportions, body lines, wheels, headlights, grille, mirrors, windows, badges, and overall identity of the vehicle.

Ultra photorealistic.

No redesign.

No exaggerated proportions.

--------------------------------------------------

# MAIN IMAGE

Large hero render occupying approximately 55–60% of the page.

Three-quarter front view.

Low camera angle.

85mm lens.

Slight steering angle.

Studio photography.

Perfect reflections.

Luxury automotive lighting.

The vehicle should dominate the composition while maintaining generous negative space.

--------------------------------------------------

# BACKGROUND

Minimal off-white museum paper.

Warm white.

Very subtle texture.

Soft gradient only.

No scenery.

No roads.

No buildings.

No sky.

No environment.

No distracting graphics.

--------------------------------------------------

# LAYOUT

Strict Swiss Grid.

Everything perfectly aligned.

Large margins.

Consistent spacing.

Invisible baseline grid.

Professional editorial hierarchy.

Every section aligned precisely.

Nothing randomly placed.

--------------------------------------------------

# HEADER

Small brand name.

Large model name.

Large year.

Small "Concept" or "Vision" subtitle.

One short design philosophy sentence.

Example:

"The next chapter of electric performance."

--------------------------------------------------

# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Create a professional engineering specification table.

Include:

Powertrain

Engine

Horsepower

Torque

Transmission

Drive Type

Battery Capacity

Range

Acceleration

Top Speed

Length

Width

Height

Wheelbase

Weight

Seats

Body Style

Platform

Use thin divider lines.

Perfect alignment.

Minimal typography.

--------------------------------------------------

# ENGINEERING DRAWINGS

Generate clean technical line drawings of the same vehicle.

Include:

Side View

Front View

Rear View

Top View

Dimension arrows.

Measurements.

Fine engineering lines.

Blueprint aesthetic.

Minimal grayscale.

--------------------------------------------------

# DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Create a short editorial paragraph describing:

• Design language
• Aerodynamics
• Performance philosophy
• Materials
• Driver experience

Professional automotive editorial tone.

Never sound like marketing.

--------------------------------------------------

# PERFORMANCE ICONS

Include minimal monochrome icons representing:

Performance

Precision

Electric

Aerodynamics

Innovation

Driver Focus

Lightweight

--------------------------------------------------

# SPECIMEN SECTION

Bottom-right corner.

Collector edition label.

Example:

Specimen

01 / 100

Limited Concept Series

Small barcode.

Internal reference number.

--------------------------------------------------

# FOOTER

Very small typography.

Examples:

Renault Design Center

Concept Vehicle

Internal Development Program

Confidential Prototype

Design Archive

Engineering Division

--------------------------------------------------

# TYPOGRAPHY

Swiss Sans Serif.

Large hierarchy.

Perfect kerning.

Perfect tracking.

Editorial spacing.

Modern typography.

Minimal.

Elegant.

No decorative fonts.

--------------------------------------------------

# COLOR PALETTE

95% monochrome.

White

Warm White

Black

Dark Grey

Light Grey

Allow only the actual vehicle color to remain.

Everything else should stay neutral.

--------------------------------------------------

# LIGHTING

Professional automotive studio.

Large softboxes.

HDR.

Soft reflections.

Controlled highlights.

Realistic metallic paint.

Detailed carbon fiber.

Detailed glass.

Detailed tires.

Detailed wheels.

Ray-traced reflections.

Physically accurate lighting.

--------------------------------------------------

# MATERIALS

Photorealistic.

No CGI appearance.

No illustration style.

Real aluminum.

Real carbon fiber.

Real rubber.

Real paint texture.

Real glass.

Microscopic surface detail.

--------------------------------------------------

# STYLE

Apple Design

Porsche Brochure

BMW Heritage

Mercedes-Benz Press Kit

Industrial Design Presentation

Swiss Graphic Design

Museum Exhibition Catalog

Automotive Design Portfolio

Luxury Print Publication

Confidential Engineering Documentation

--------------------------------------------------

# NEGATIVE PROMPT

No scenery

No roads

No mountains

No city

No people

No drivers

No motion blur

No smoke

No racing effects

No explosions

No colorful graphics

No visual clutter

No comic style

No cartoon

No painterly look

No CGI look

No unrealistic reflections

No exaggerated proportions

No incorrect wheels

No fake badges

No watermark

No signatures

No borders

No low-quality typography

No distorted perspective

No unnecessary decorative elements

--------------------------------------------------

# FINAL RESULT

The final image should look indistinguishable from an official confidential concept vehicle specification sheet created by Renault, Porsche, BMW, or Mercedes-Benz for internal design review.

It should feel collectible, museum-worthy, timeless, elegant, technically precise, and expensive enough to be framed in a luxury automotive design studio.

prompts.title: Premium Vertical Automotive Poster
prompts.promptText:
# ROLE
You are an award-winning automotive advertising designer specializing in minimalist luxury poster design and high-end editorial layouts.

# OBJECTIVE
Create a premium vertical automotive poster inspired by classic automotive magazine advertisements from the 1980s–2000s.

Do NOT copy any existing poster exactly.
Instead recreate the same visual language:
oversized typography, minimalist composition, dramatic studio lighting, monochrome aesthetic, premium editorial feel.

# CANVAS

Orientation: Portrait
Aspect Ratio: 4:5
Resolution: 8K
Print Quality
Ultra Sharp
Professional Poster

# SUBJECT

Car:
[CAR MODEL]

Brand:
[CAR BRAND]

Year:
[YEAR]

Color:
[CAR COLOR]

Body Style:
[SEDAN / SUV / HATCHBACK / COUPE / PICKUP]

# COMPOSITION

The car occupies the lower-middle portion of the canvas.

Camera angle:
Three-quarter front view

Low camera perspective

Slight wheel turn

Hero angle

Large negative space above the vehicle.

Massive bold typography fills almost the entire background.

Typography should read:

"[MODEL NAME]"

Typography is placed behind the car.

The vehicle overlaps the text naturally.

Text extends almost from top to bottom.

The letters fade subtly toward the bottom.

# LOGO

Place the official manufacturer logo in the top-right corner.

Small.

Minimal.

Elegant.

# LIGHTING

Luxury studio lighting

Soft top light

Large softboxes

Strong reflections

Clean highlights

Deep shadows

Crisp reflections on paint

Photorealistic metal

Realistic glass

Realistic headlights

High contrast

No harsh clipping

# BACKGROUND

Pure white background

Soft grey gradient near floor

Dark floor

Subtle shadow beneath vehicle

No scenery

No environment

No buildings

No roads

No distractions

Minimalist studio

# LOWER SECTION

Bottom left:

Minimal line-art illustration of the same vehicle.

Below it:

Brand Logo

Model Name

Year

Bottom center:

A short premium editorial paragraph describing the vehicle.

Bottom right:

Technical specifications displayed in clean magazine layout.

Include:

Engine

Horsepower

Torque

Transmission

Drivetrain

Fuel Type

Fuel Economy

Seats

Body Type

Dimensions

# DESIGN STYLE

Swiss graphic design

Editorial layout

Automotive brochure

Minimalism

Luxury branding

Modern typography

High-end print advertisement

Museum-quality poster

Apple-level simplicity

Porsche brochure aesthetics

BMW heritage advertising

Mercedes-Benz catalog design

# COLORS

Mostly monochrome.

Black

White

Grey

Silver

Allow only the actual car color to remain if desired.

Otherwise produce a full black-and-white poster.

# MATERIAL QUALITY

Ultra photorealistic

Realistic reflections

Real paint texture

Detailed wheels

Detailed tires

Detailed badges

Clean glass

Detailed grille

High fidelity

No CGI look

No cartoon style

No illustration

No painterly effects

# TYPOGRAPHY

Huge condensed sans-serif font

Very bold

Very tall

Minimal spacing

Perfect alignment

Editorial composition

Premium kerning

Professional print typography

# CAMERA

85mm lens

Low perspective

f/8

ISO 100

Studio photography

Ultra sharp

HDR

Professional automotive photography

# RENDER QUALITY

Photorealistic

Hyper detailed

8K

Maximum detail

Global illumination

Ray-traced reflections

Physically accurate lighting

Print-ready

Luxury automotive advertising

Award-winning graphic design

No watermark

No signatures

No borders

No extra objects

No people

No motion blur

No visual clutter

The final image should look like a premium collector's edition automotive poster that could be framed and displayed in a luxury showroom.
